description: This is a false-colour satellite image from Spot 5, featuring a landscape in Norway at 2.5-metre resolution using a 1/2/3 band combination. A bright blue river flows diagonally from the top-left to the mid-left of the image, cutting through a mountainous or hilly region. The dominant land cover is depicted in a greenish-blue hue, representing bare rock and areas with sparse vegetation, specifically less than 10% cover. Scattered across these steep hillsides and along the river are numerous distinct patches of bright red, which indicate areas of vegetation, including birch trees, as specified by the surrounding context. The terrain displays significant erosion and topographical relief.
